subject: GreenBank: purge request for prompts/outputs/logs - orchestration & closure
messages:
From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@greenbank.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@greenbank.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: deletion request for PII prompts and inference logs

Hi Kimberly,

We're following up on the conversation our security team had with your compliance contact. GreenBank needs Redwood to remove all customer-specific prompts, model outputs, and inference/log artifacts tied to the following customer IDs and time ranges as part of our data minimization obligations:

- account_id: GB-77821
- affected user ids: gb_user_1221, gb_user_1229
- time range: 2025-01-01 through 2026-09-01

Required deliverables:
- Confirmation of the scope you will remove (prompts, generation outputs, KV caches, temporary inference logs, backup blobs).
- Estimated completion date and proof artifacts we can use for our audit (manifest + hash proofs + ops checkpoint).
- Clarification on whether embeddings and analytics aggregates are included by default or need a separate request.

I attached our signed deletion_request_form.pdf. Please let me know if you need anything signed from our side to proceed; we need to include the proof in the audit packet next month.

Thanks,
Lisa Nguyen
Director, Data Operations | GreenBank
lisa.nguyen@greenbank.com
+1 415 555 0132

-----Original Message Attachment: greenbank_deletion_request_form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@greenbank.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: deletion request for PII prompts and inference logs

Hi Lisa —

Thanks for sending the form and the clear scope. We can take this request and run a coordinated purge across our hosted and backup stores. High-level intake and plan below: 

1) Scope confirmation (today): we will remove
   - Prompt traces (full request payloads tied to GB IDs)
   - Generated outputs (response texts and structured outputs)
   - Runtime KV cache entries associated with the GB account and the user ids you listed
   - Short-term inference logs and temporary artifacts (traces, intermediate tensors)
   - Backup blobs older than the retention window where they contain the scoped identifiers

   We will NOT remove aggregated telemetry or anonymized usage metrics unless you explicitly request it. Embeddings: those are treated as derivations; we need explicit confirmation if you want embeddings removed — please confirm.

2) Timeline and milestones
   - Intake & ticket creation (this message): 2026-09-11
   - Ops purge execution window: 2026-09-14 (various jobs to minimize impact)
   - Audit package (manifest + hash proofs + checkpoint logs): within 24 hours of completion

3) Verification & proof
   - We produce a CSV manifest of removed objects, sha256 hashes, and a redwood-erase job checkpoint log. If you need signed proof, we can generate a DocuSign acknowledgement.

4) Approvals / blockers
   - Please confirm: remove embeddings? (yes/no)
   - Any legal hold or regulatory exception for the listed user ids?

I've looped in Rishi (serving/runtime) and Marcus (ops) to run the erase playbook and draft the manifest format.

Action items:
- Lisa: reply with embeddings decision and any hold flags by EOD PT 2026-09-12
- Rishi/Marcus: prepare erase playbook and test manifest template

Appreciate the quick turnaround here — we'll prioritize this.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenBank purge request - technical plan

Kimberly / Marcus —

I reviewed the scope. Technical plan (concise):

A) Job orchestration
   - Create a one-time run of redwood-erase-v2 targeting GB account namespace and the two user ids. Jobs will run in a staged manner to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

B) Artifact classes and method
   - Prompts & outputs: delete objects from object store (S3) where metadata.account_id = GB-77821 and metadata.user in {gb_user_1221, gb_user_1229}; remove corresponding DB index entries.
   - KV cache: issue a key-prefix sweep + tombstone and TTL-accelerated eviction; verify KV cluster compaction afterward.
   - Inference logs: rotate and securely purge local ephemeral logs, then overwrite with zeroed files where required per our erase guidance.
   - Backups: scan snapshots for metadata links then schedule a snapshot-level purge if object pointers exist (may require coordination with cloud backup vendor).

C) Proof artifacts produced
   - erase_manifest_20260914.csv (columns: object_type, object_id, storage_path, sha256, removed_at_utc)
   - ops_checkpoint_20260914.log (sequenced steps + job ids)
   - sample_hashes.txt (per-object sha256 before deletion, stored in restricted audit bucket)

D) Embeddings and derived vectors
   - These are stored in a separate vector store cluster; if GreenBank confirms, we will run a vector-purge routine that deletes vectors matching account metadata and reindexes affected partitions. This adds ~6 hours to the ETA.

E) ETA & SLOs
   - Plan to start: 2026-09-14 03:00 UTC
   - Expected completion (without embeddings): 2026-09-14 17:00 UTC
   - With embeddings: 2026-09-15 01:00 UTC

F) Risks & notes
   - Snapshot/backups may need vendor approval; if vendor retention windows block deletion we will provide a mitigation note and estimated removal window.
   - We will not change any production model weights.

Attached: erase_manifest_template.csv (empty template) — Marcus, please stage the playbook and confirm the job ids for the ops checkpoint.

-r
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: erase_manifest_template.csv (text/csv)

Subject: Re: GreenBank: purge request for PII prompts and inference logs - orchestration & closure

Hi Lisa —

This is to confirm completion of the purge for the scope GreenBank requested (account GB-77821, gb_user_1221, gb_user_1229, date range 2025-01-01 -> 2026-09-01). Summary:

- Execution window: 2026-09-14 03:05 UTC -> 2026-09-14 16:52 UTC
- Removed artifact classes: prompt traces, generation outputs, runtime KV cache entries, short-term inference logs, referenced backup blobs where pointers existed.
- Embeddings: not removed (no confirmation from GreenBank). If you want these removed we will run the vector-purge routine; let us know and we will schedule.

Proof package (attached / links):
- erase_manifest_20260914.csv — manifest of removed objects (object_type, object_id, storage_path, sha256, removed_at_utc)
- ops_checkpoint_20260914.log — sequenced job log with job ids and final status (SUCCESS)
- sample_hashes.txt — per-object sha256 that was computed and archived to our restricted audit bucket before deletion
- Drive proof folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/GB-erase-2026-09-14-proof 

Notes:
- Backups: one older snapshot contained pointers to removed objects; we coordinated with our backup vendor and marked the snapshot for removal. Vendor retention windows may delay actual physical reclamation; we included the snapshot id and the vendor ticket in ops_checkpoint_20260914.log.
- No legal holds or retention exceptions were discovered for the listed user ids.

Next steps for closure: please reply to this thread confirming receipt of the proof artifacts and whether you would like embeddings included in the scope. After your acknowledgement we will mark the internal ticket as CLOSED and provide a short entry for your audit packet.

Thanks for working with us on the timeline — let me know if you need anything else.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachments: erase_manifest_20260914.csv, ops_checkpoint_20260914.log, sample_hashes.txt
